import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    u_idx = np.asarray(local_opt_tour)
    v_idx = np.roll(u_idx, -1)
    w_idx = np.roll(u_idx, 1)
    edge_n_used *= 0.95
    tour_dists = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    pred_dists = edge_distance[w_idx, u_idx]
    tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    utilities = tour_dists / (1.0 + tour_used)
    k_penalize = max(1, int(np.ceil(0.10 * n)))
    top_indices = np.argpartition(utilities, -k_penalize)[-k_penalize:]
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        edge_n_used[u, v] += 1.0
        edge_n_used[v, u] += 1.0
    mean_tour_dist = np.mean(tour_dists) + 1e-12
    updated_tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    overlap_ratio = np.mean(updated_tour_used > 1.0)
    stagnation_factor = 1.0 + 1.5 * overlap_ratio
    skip_dists = edge_distance[w_idx, v_idx]
    chord_base = skip_dists + 1e-12
    incident_sum = pred_dists + tour_dists
    zigzag_tension = incident_sum / chord_base
    norm_tension = zigzag_tension / (np.mean(zigzag_tension) + 1e-12)
    replacement_ratio = skip_dists / (tour_dists + 1e-12)
    norm_irreplaceability = replacement_ratio / (np.mean(replacement_ratio) + 1e-12)
    pred_used = edge_n_used[w_idx, u_idx]
    succ_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    tot_used = pred_used + succ_used + 1e-12
    p1 = pred_used / tot_used
    p2 = succ_used / tot_used
    incident_entropy = -(p1 * np.log2(np.maximum(p1, 1e-12)) + p2 * np.log2(np.maximum(p2, 1e-12)))
    base_penalty_scale = 0.25 * mean_tour_dist * stagnation_factor
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        strain_mod = 0.5 * (norm_tension[idx] + norm_tension[(idx + 1) % n])
        irreplaceability_mod = 0.5 * (norm_irreplaceability[idx] + norm_irreplaceability[(idx + 1) % n])
        entropy_mod = 0.5 * (incident_entropy[idx] + incident_entropy[(idx + 1) % n])
        rel_len = tour_dists[idx] / mean_tour_dist
        modulation = 1.0 + 0.35 * rel_len + 0.25 * strain_mod + 0.20 * entropy_mod - 0.25 * irreplaceability_mod
        modulation = max(0.4, modulation)
        penalty = base_penalty_scale * modulation * edge_n_used[u, v]
        updated_edge_distance[u, v] += penalty
        updated_edge_distance[v, u] += penalty
    return updated_edge_distance

    u_idx = np.asarray(local_opt_tour)

    tour_dists = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]

    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        edge_n_used[u, v] += 1.0
        edge_n_used[v, u] += 1.0
    mean_tour_dist = np.mean(tour_dists) + 1e-12
    penalized_nodes = np.unique(np.concatenate((u_idx[top_indices], v_idx[top_indices])))
    sub_usage = edge_n_used[penalized_nodes, :]
    row_sums = np.sum(sub_usage, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
    probs = sub_usage / row_sums
    entropy = -np.sum(probs * np.log(probs + 1e-12), axis=1)
    max_entropy = np.log(n) + 1e-12
    node_rigidity = np.zeros(n)
    node_rigidity[penalized_nodes] = np.clip(1.0 - (entropy / max_entropy), 0.0, 1.0)
    updated_tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    prev_tour_used = edge_n_used[w_idx, u_idx]
    next_v = np.roll(v_idx, -1)
    next_tour_used = edge_n_used[v_idx, next_v]
    chain_persistence = (prev_tour_used + 2.0 * updated_tour_used + next_tour_used) / 4.0
    chain_persistence_norm = chain_persistence / (np.mean(chain_persistence) + 1e-12)
    tour_neighbor_dist = 0.5 * (edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx] + edge_distance[u_idx, w_idx]) + 1e-12

    base_penalty_scale = 0.25 * mean_tour_dist
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        rel_len = tour_dists[idx] / mean_tour_dist
        density_mod = 0.5 * (norm_density[u] + norm_density[v])
        rigidity_mod = 0.5 * (node_rigidity[u] + node_rigidity[v])

    v_idx = np.roll(u_idx, -1)

    overlap_ratio = np.mean(tour_used > 0.8)
    avg_tour_usage = np.mean(tour_used)
    max_used = np.max(edge_n_used) + 1e-12
    stagnation_ratio = avg_tour_usage / max_used
    stagnation_severity = 0.6 * overlap_ratio + 0.4 * stagnation_ratio
    k_frac = 0.04 + 0.14 * (stagnation_severity ** 1.5)
    k_penalize = max(1, min(n - 1, int(np.ceil(k_frac * n))))
    utilities = tour_dists / (1.0 + tour_used)
    top_indices = np.argpartition(utilities, -k_penalize)[-k_penalize:]
    selected_u = u_idx[top_indices]
    selected_v = v_idx[top_indices]
    edge_n_used[selected_u, selected_v] += 1.0
    edge_n_used[selected_v, selected_u] += 1.0
    w_idx = np.roll(u_idx, 1)
    tour_neighbor_dist = 0.5 * (tour_dists + edge_distance[u_idx, w_idx]) + 1e-12
    local_density = mean_tour_dist / tour_neighbor_dist
    norm_density = local_density / (np.max(local_density) + 1e-12)
    stagnation_factor = 1.0 + 1.8 * overlap_ratio + 0.7 * stagnation_ratio
    base_penalty_scale = 0.22 * mean_tour_dist * stagnation_factor
    rel_lens = tour_dists[top_indices] / mean_tour_dist
    density_mods = 0.5 * (norm_density[selected_u] + norm_density[selected_v])
    usage_weights = edge_n_used[selected_u, selected_v]
    penalties = base_penalty_scale * (1.0 + 0.4 * rel_lens + 0.6 * density_mods) * usage_weights
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (selected_u, selected_v), penalties)
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (selected_v, selected_u), penalties)
    return updated_edge_distance

        rel_len = tour_dists[idx] / mean_tour_dist

    left_penalties = np.roll(edge_penalties, 1) * spread_factor

import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    u_idx = np.asarray(local_opt_tour)
    v_idx = np.roll(u_idx, -1)
    edge_n_used *= 0.95
    tour_dists = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    utilities = tour_dists / (1.0 + tour_used)
    k_penalize = max(1, int(np.ceil(0.10 * n)))
    top_indices = np.argpartition(utilities, -k_penalize)[-k_penalize:]
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        edge_n_used[u, v] += 1.0
        edge_n_used[v, u] += 1.0
    updated_tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    mean_tour_dist = np.mean(tour_dists) + 1e-12
    overlap_ratio = np.mean(updated_tour_used > 1.0)
    stagnation_factor = 1.0 + 1.5 * overlap_ratio
    w_idx = np.roll(u_idx, 1)
    tour_neighbor_dist = 0.5 * (edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx] + edge_distance[u_idx, w_idx]) + 1e-12
    local_density = mean_tour_dist / tour_neighbor_dist
    norm_density = local_density / (np.max(local_density) + 1e-12)
    base_penalty_scale = 0.25 * mean_tour_dist * stagnation_factor
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        rel_len = tour_dists[idx] / mean_tour_dist
        density_mod = 0.5 * (norm_density[u] + norm_density[v])
        usage_val = edge_n_used[u, v]
        freq_response = np.sqrt(usage_val) * (1.0 + 0.5 * np.tanh(usage_val / 4.0))
        length_factor = np.exp(np.clip(rel_len - 1.0, -1.0, 3.0))
        modulation = length_factor * (1.0 + 0.4 * density_mod)
        penalty = base_penalty_scale * freq_response * modulation
        updated_edge_distance[u, v] += penalty
        updated_edge_distance[v, u] += penalty
    return updated_edge_distance
